name: smwpatches-show-level-number
title: Show Level Number V3
description:
Installing this patch will show the current sublevel's level number as it appears in Lunar Magic.

It overwrites the player's score with...
"LVL 105"
(Where 105 is the level number)
You can configure it to display other things if you want though.

5-16-2010: This one fixes a glitch where at the very start of the level it doesn't show up, and actually disables the score. If you've already patched the previous version, you should be able to repatch this fine.

Yoshifanatic's update:
- The code has been significantly optimized.
- No longer uses free space by overwriting the score display code.
- Updated the patch for asar 2.0 compatibility.
- No longer disables getting points.
- Added functionality to disable displaying leading zeros.
